title: Audio responses keep their audio
summary:
Audio responses keep their data, the homepage gets a tidier footer, and image generation gets sturdier workers and clearer usage tracking.

The chat completion response schema now includes an optional audio object, so `openai-audio` responses can retain their transcript and base64-encoded audio data.

The homepage footer gained a responsive black-and-white layout with contact details and link columns. The X link was restored, and the News section can now be linked to directly.

Flux workers now scale oversized requests toward a 768×768 pixel budget to reduce GPU out-of-memory failures. Image models also share a token-tracking field, so Nano Banana usage headers can reflect the token count reported by Vertex AI instead of defaulting to one.
